```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
library(testthat)
library(htmltools)
```

# Overview

This report runs the email-related test files and summarizes results.

```{r discover-files}
# Determine project root (so this works when knitting from tests/testthat/)
root_dir <- if (file.exists("src")) {
  "."
} else if (file.exists("../src")) {
  ".."
} else if (file.exists("../../src")) {
  "../.."
} else {
  "."
}

test_files <- file.path(root_dir, c(
  "tests/testthat/test-email-features.R",
  "tests/testthat/test-email-credentials.R",
  "tests/testthat/test-email-report-generation.R",
  "tests/testthat/test-email-integration.R"
))
existing_test_files <- test_files[file.exists(test_files)]
``` 

```{r validate-files}
if (length(existing_test_files) == 0) {
  stop("No email test files found.")
}
```

# Summary

```{r run-tests-collect}
count_tests_in_file <- function(path) {
  lines <- tryCatch(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character())
  sum(grepl("\\btest_that\\s*\\(", lines))
}

total_tests <- 0
per_file_counts <- data.frame(
  file = basename(existing_test_files),
  tests = integer(length(existing_test_files)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(existing_test_files)) {
  per_file_counts$tests[i] <- count_tests_in_file(existing_test_files[i])
  total_tests <- total_tests + per_file_counts$tests[i]
}

htmltools::div(
  htmltools::h4("Email Test Totals"),
  htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::tags$b("Total test files:"), length(existing_test_files)),
  htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::tags$b("Total tests:"), total_tests)
)
```

```{r per-file-table}
knitr::kable(per_file_counts, caption = "Per-file test counts")
```

# Execution Output

The chunks below execute each test file with the summary reporter so you can see pass/fail output inline.

```{r run-features}
cat("\n==== test-email-features.R ====\n")
testthat::test_file(file.path(root_dir, "tests/testthat/test-email-features.R"), reporter = "summary")
```

```{r run-credentials}
cat("\n==== test-email-credentials.R ====\n")
testthat::test_file(file.path(root_dir, "tests/testthat/test-email-credentials.R"), reporter = "summary")
```

```{r run-report-generation}
cat("\n==== test-email-report-generation.R ====\n")
testthat::test_file(file.path(root_dir, "tests/testthat/test-email-report-generation.R"), reporter = "summary")
```

```{r run-integration}
cat("\n==== test-email-integration.R ====\n")
testthat::test_file(file.path(root_dir, "tests/testthat/test-email-integration.R"), reporter = "summary")
```

# Notes

- Totals are computed from occurrences of `test_that(` in each file.
- See the Execution Output sections for detailed pass/fail logs.
